Position Title: Senior Front-End Engineer (Angular)

Department: Technology

Reports To: Engineering Manager

Location: US, remote

One Inc does not offer visa sponsorship, including H1-B sponsorship. One Inc does not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from staffing agencies or recruiters.

Overview: One Inc is seeking a Senior Front-End Engineer (Angular) to design, build, and own modern, scalable web applications that power critical consumer payment and onboarding workflows. In this role, you will translate complex business and payment logic into intuitive, secure, and high-performance user interfaces.

You will work closely with Product, Design, Backend, and QA teams, while also helping define frontend standards, architecture, and best practices. This role requires strong technical depth in Angular, a product mindset, and a high level of ownership from design through production.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and maintain production grade Angular applications used in customer facing platforms

- Own front-end delivery end-to-end, from requirements and technical design through release and ongoing maintenance

- Collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, backend engineers, and QA to deliver cohesive solutions

- Translate complex workflows and payment logic into simple, intuitive, and accessible user experiences

- Define and uphold front-end architecture, coding standards, and reusable component patterns

- Contribute to and maintain shared UI components or design systems

- Optimize applications for performance, accessibility (WCAG), responsiveness, and cross browser compatibility

- Integrate with RESTful and event driven APIs, including authentication and authorization flows

- Ensure frontend implementations comply with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements

- Participate in code reviews, provide technical guidance, and mentor other engineers

- Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term frontend technical strategy

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 6-8+ years of experience building modern, production web applications

- Deep, hands-on experience with Angular and its ecosystem (TypeScript, RxJS, Angular CLI)

- Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS

- Experience with state management patterns and tools (NgRx or similar)

- Solid understanding of modular front-end architecture and component-based design

- Experience integrating with backend APIs and handling authentication flows

- Experience working with relational databases like MS SQL and PostgreSQL, good understanding of database principles and ACID properties

- Strong knowledge of web performance optimization and accessibility standards

- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience implementing ASP.NET based microservices and BFFs

- Experience in payments, fintech, or other regulated industries

- Familiarity with PCI compliant or security sensitive user workflows

- Exposure to design systems or micro front-end architectures

- Hands-on experience with front-end testing frameworks (unit and E2E; Cypress preferred)

- Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Desired Traits:

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability

- Comfortable operating in complex, fastmoving environments

- User-focused mindset with attention to detail and quality

- Willingness to influence technical standards and help elevate the team

Additional Requirements:

- This position may periodically require work outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends, to support business needs.

- Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background screening requirements.

- One Inc may conduct periodic background checks at any time during employment, as permitted by applicable law and company policy.

Physical Demands:

The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Environment:

Standard indoor office setting; exposure to computer screens.

Physical:

Requires repetitive motion. Substantial movements/motions of the wrists hands, and/or fingers. Sufficient mobility to work in an office setting; stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; operate office equipment including use of a computer keyboard, mouse, scanner and other tools as needed.

Vision:

See in the normal vision range with or without correction; vision sufficient to read computer screens and printed documents.

Hearing:

Ability to hear in the normal audio range with or without corrections.

Company Profile: At One Inc, we empower insurers to meet policyholder expectations with choice, control, convenience, and continuity. Our mission is simple: to make every payment a promise kept.

The One Inc Insurance Payments Network seamlessly integrates multi-channel digital communications with inbound payment processing and outbound disbursement, delivering a frictionless experience for both premiums and claim payments. With over $120 billion in annual payments volume, we are proud to serve more than 300 insurance carriers, helping them honor their commitments instantly and securely.

Headquartered in Folsom, CA, One Inc offers competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits — including medical, dental, and vision insurance — a 401(k) plan, and a strong commitment to work-life balance. We believe in growing from within, promoting opportunities for career advancement across our team of 1,200+ dedicated "Onesters."

Join us in building the infrastructure that fulfills the promise of insurance.

One Inc is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all EEOC legislation in each jurisdiction it operates in.

Education

Preferred

-
Bachelors or better

Equal Opportunity Employer

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Infrastructure / Product Engineer based in the United States.

Join an innovative healthtech environment leveraging artificial intelligence to transform complex legal workflows and improve operational efficiency. As an AI Infrastructure / Product Engineer, you will bridge the gap between AI research and practical product development, turning experimental technologies into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will design and implement evaluation frameworks, backend services, and infrastructure that ensure AI systems deliver accurate, efficient, and consistent results. Working closely with AI researchers and product teams, you will contribute to the development of intelligent retrieval, document automation, drafting, and agent-based workflows. You will also play a key role in monitoring system performance, optimizing infrastructure, and establishing engineering best practices. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the practical application of AI in a high-impact industry while working in a collaborative, technically driven environment.

Accountabilities:

- AI Evaluation and Performance Optimization:

- Design, build, and maintain repeatable benchmarks and evaluation pipelines to measure the performance of AI and machine learning systems.

- Assess model accuracy, hallucination rates, retrieval quality, latency, and operational costs to ensure reliable system performance.

- Develop dashboards and monitoring tools that provide clear visibility into performance metrics, system improvements, and potential issues.

- Establish evaluation processes that support continuous testing, comparison, and optimization of AI models and workflows.

- AI Product and Application Development:

- Transform research prototypes and experimental AI capabilities into reliable, production-ready applications.

- Develop and improve AI-powered retrieval, document processing, drafting, and agent-based workflows.

- Collaborate with AI research teams to integrate new models, techniques, and research findings into practical product features.

- Ensure technical implementations remain aligned with product requirements, user needs, and real-world operational challenges.

- Backend Engineering and Infrastructure:

- Design, develop, and maintain backend services, APIs, and internal tools that support AI testing, deployment, and product releases.

- Build and optimize databases, cloud infrastructure, and deployment pipelines to support scalable AI applications.

- Implement monitoring, observability, and performance management solutions to maintain system reliability and availability.

- Support the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of cloud-based services and infrastructure.

- Develop maintainable, well-structured software that supports efficient testing, integration, and future product development.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration:

- Work closely with AI researchers, product teams, and engineers to translate technical research into valuable product capabilities.

- Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions related to AI infrastructure, evaluation methodologies, and product development.

- Identify technical challenges and opportunities for improvement, proactively proposing and implementing effective solutions.

- Help establish engineering practices that promote reliability, scalability, maintainability, and continuous innovation.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Product Engineer, or in a related engineering role building and deploying production systems.

- Strong programming skills in Python, with practical experience developing, maintaining, and deploying software applications.

- Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and the deployment and operation of production software systems.

- Demonstrated experience building evaluation pipelines, benchmarks, or assessment frameworks for machine learning or AI-powered applications.

- Understanding of AI performance evaluation, including model accuracy, hallucination detection, retrieval quality, latency, and cost optimization.

- Experience developing backend services, REST APIs, database integrations, and internal engineering tools.

- Familiarity with deployment pipelines, system monitoring, observability, and performance dashboards.

- Ability to transform experimental code, research prototypes, and loosely defined requirements into reliable, maintainable, and user-friendly production solutions.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate complex technical challenges and deliver practical solutions.

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, AI research, and product teams.

- A proactive and adaptable mindset, with the ability to work independently, manage priorities, and contribute to a rapidly evolving technical environment.

Nice to Have:

- Full-stack software development experience.

- Familiarity with FastAPI, Docker, React, Next.js, and PostgreSQL.

- Experience working with vector databases and modern data retrieval technologies.

- Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agent architectures.

- Familiarity with AI benchmarks, model evaluation methodologies, and document automation workflows.

- Previous experience building AI-powered products or working in healthcare technology or other regulated industries.

Benefits:

- Competitive Compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $180,000 to $260,000 USD, depending on skills, professional experience, and role scope.

- Remote Work: Fully remote position within the United States.

- Professional Growth: Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI research, infrastructure engineering, and product development.

- Technical Impact: Direct involvement in transforming experimental AI technologies into reliable, production-ready applications.

- Innovation: Exposure to advanced AI technologies, LLMs, retrieval systems, and intelligent automation solutions.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, and product professionals to solve meaningful technical challenges.

- Career Development: Opportunity to expand technical expertise and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered healthcare and legal workflow solutions.

How Jobgether works:

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

company_object.description:
Jobgether is a career navigation platform built for senior professionals competing in the remote job market. Hiring systems were designed for volume and keyword matching, not for 15 or 20 years of nonlinear experience. That structural mismatch is why strong profiles get filtered out before a human ever sees them.

Our platform diagnoses where a search is breaking, corrects how experience is positioned, and connects professionals to the companies where their background creates real value. The goal is not more applications. It is the right visibility in the right places.

Our mission is to ensure no senior professional remains invisible in the global remote market, not because they lack the skills, but because the system failed to read them correctly.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a high-autonomy engineer to build the SportsBiz platform from the ground up. You will bridge heavy data pipelines to polished user interfaces, owning architecture across the entire stack.

About Northbeam

Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi-touch attribution, MMM+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser-accurate first-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions.

We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast-moving, high-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey.

We're a remote-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles.

About the Role

As a Staff Fullstack Engineer at Northbeam, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering high-quality fullstack web solutions that support our business. You will own major product features across the stack from design to launch. You'll have close feedback loops with users, Product Managers, and our Customer Success team. You will work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers and domain experts to build a scalable product, implement robust software components, and ensure the reliability and performance of our platform. Your technical expertise, communication skills, and problem-solving ability will contribute to the success of our company and shape the future of our technology stack.

Curiosity, willingness to do the hard thing, attention to developer ergonomics, and an enjoyment of a startup pace of development will be the key to success in this role.

Your Impact

You can expect to work on the following:

- Identify and solve complex, high-impact problems, leading projects with multiple stakeholders and engineers to deliver significant impact to our business

- Help set technical direction impacting our engineering team

- Work with product managers, our customer success team, and customers to scope projects and build solutions

- Build the Northbeam dashboard, where we surface core marketing analytics

- Own and build features end-to-end yourself from idea to production-ready solution, as well as with engineers across the company

- Optimize our web application for best-in-class speed of development and time to render

- Contribute to the development of standardized, technical documentation for internal and external stakeholders

What you bring

- 5+ years of expertise in building frontend and backend systems with TypeScript

- 3+ years of expertise with modern component-based libraries such as React

- Experience handling creating API services using REST and GraphQL

- Proficiency in SQL and BigQuery

- Be independent, dedicated, and able to deliver production-ready code with high autonomy and minimal guidance

- Ability to drive rapid development while ensuring maintainability, balancing short-term delivery needs with long-term systems design.

- Passion for continuous learning and professional growth

- Proven interest and ability to mentor other engineers on the team

Nice to have

- Proficiency in Python

- Experience building design systems

- Experience optimizing frontends for large amounts of data and time spent loading

- Experience working with data visualization

- Experience working in marketing, e-commerce, or ad-tech

Values

These are the values we share as the Northbeam community:

- Growth mindset - we're always learning and growing

- Customer focus - we want to make the customer happy with our product

- Ownership mentality - we think like owners in the business

- Radical candor - we're transparent and give direct feedback to one another

Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location.

In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work-from-home stipend to support your remote setup.

Interview Process

The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5-7 interviews total and requires around 5-8 hours of your time.

We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

data.description:
Join an early-stage startup.
Accelerate economic opportunity.

Join us to grow Kovo's core product. Credit building is the business that got us here, and it's still growing fast. You'll have end-to-end responsibility: onboarding, lifecycle, conversion and retention. You set the roadmap and you build what you find.

This role is a good fit if:

-
You've shipped code to production and you've decided what to build.

-
You go deep on funnels, workflows and lifecycle systems, and find the opportunity others missed.

-
When you find a fix, you open a PR instead of writing a ticket.

-
You think in experiments and measured lift, not campaign sends.

-
You want to inform the direction for a product.

About us

-
Kovo is expanding access to financial tools for people historically excluded from the traditional credit system. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity for economic independence, and we're building products that help people establish financial identity and unlock opportunity.

-
Over the past three years, Kovo has grown revenue 20x while maintaining exceptional capital efficiency. We rank above the 99th percentile in revenue per employee benchmarks, reflecting the leverage of a small, high-performing team.

-
The team combines the ambition of a venture-scale company with the discipline of a profitable business. We reached positive free cash flow early in our lifecycle, allowing us to grow with less dilution and focus on building for the long term.

-
Kovo is backed by Inspired Capital and Homebrew, and built by alumni from Plaid, Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Innovis, Chime, Robinhood, Cash App, Honey, Possible, Monzo, Mercury, and more. We're looking for exceptional people to help us scale the company another 20x and beyond.

Why you might be excited about us

-
Direct impact on millions of people's ability to access credit

-
High ownership with minimal bureaucracy

-
Speed, learning, and impact are core values

Why you might not be excited about us

-
Roles and priorities evolve quickly

-
Some systems and processes are still being built

-
The pace of execution and career growth is intense (not optimized for work-life balance)

About the role

What you inherit

-
Two feature-complete credit builder products that report to all four major bureaus.

-
Onboarding, lifecycle messaging (email, push, in-app, SMS) and growth experiments across web and app.

-
A lifecycle stack migration to PostHog, alongside product analytics and experiments in PostHog.

-
Sandbox environments that let you prototype on the real product.

Where your time goes

-
Most of it: finding and shipping the highest-leverage improvements across the existing product.

-
Some of it: building a system that runs experiments with fewer humans in the loop every quarter.

-
A little of it: setting the roadmap and keeping the team informed.

What you'll do

Set the direction

-
Own the north star, input metrics, roadmap and quarterly plan for the core product, the same way each engineering team owns its own.

-
Rank bets by measured impact on conversion, retention and lifetime value. Keep the list short.

-
Write short updates about results, not activity.

Find the opportunity

-
Go deep on onboarding, payment and lifecycle workflows. Watch sessions, query the data, read support conversations.

-
Size each opportunity before you build it.

Build it

-
Prototype in sandbox environments, then ship production PRs yourself. Use agents heavily.

-
Instrument events cleanly, and fix event and property gaps yourself.

-
Run experiments end-to-end: hypothesis, sizing, launch and readout.

-
Own the lifecycle system: workflows, templates, triggers and monitoring.

-
Build agentic workflows that propose, launch and read out experiments with less of you every quarter.

What you won't do

-
Write tickets for someone else to build or do what you could build or do yourself.

-
Groom a backlog.

-
Write a PRD when a prototype or a PR would answer the question faster.

-
Hand off a spec and wait.

About you

Mindset

-
You want to own outcomes, and you measure yourself by what moved.

-
Energized by helping underserved people build credit and financial identity.

-
Comfortable in a high-intensity, remote role with full ownership and little scaffolding.

-
You hate AI slop. You use agents heavily and hold their output to a higher bar than your own.

How you work

-
PR first. You fix what you find.

-
Data first. You write your own SQL and read your own experiments.

-
Clear, short writer. People act on your message after one read.

Experience

-
4+ years, or equivalent depth, in product engineering, growth engineering, or a product role where you shipped your own code.

-
You've shipped production code recently, in TypeScript, React or similar. AI-assisted counts.

-
A track record of measured wins in activation, conversion, retention or reactivation in a consumer product.

-
Comfortable with event-driven systems, product analytics, experiment design, and lifecycle platforms. Intermediate SQL or better.

-
Bonus: Consumer fintech experience.

You report to one of the founders, based in Austin, TX. We are fully remote. Austin is a plus, not a requirement.

#LI-Remote
